category_edits.rationale: Blend each recurrent state with its causal recency-weighted mean using 0.9/0.1 coefficients. Existing masking and five-interaction half-life remain intact. This applies to all four datasets, and the generated predictor imports the same model class.

change_summary: Correct the readout to 90% recurrent state plus 10% recency-weighted pooling, consistently in training and inference.
